content: When using ORTHO TRI-CYCLEN® or ORTHO-CYCLEN®, the first tablet should be taken on the first Sunday following the onset of menstruation. If menstruation begins on a Sunday, the first tablet should be taken on that same day. One active tablet is taken daily for 21 consecutive days, followed by one green inactive tablet daily for 7 days. After completing the 28 tablets, a new course is initiated the next day, which is also a Sunday. During the first cycle of a Sunday Start regimen, an additional contraceptive method should be used until after the first 7 consecutive days of active tablet administration. For a Day 1 Start regimen, the dosage of ORTHO TRI-CYCLEN® or ORTHO-CYCLEN® begins with one active tablet taken daily starting on the first day of menstrual flow, which is considered Day 1, and continues through Day 21. This is followed by one green inactive tablet daily for 7 days. Tablets are taken continuously for 28 days without interruption. After completing the 28 tablets, a new course is started the following day. For the treatment of acne, the initiation of ORTHO TRI-CYCLEN® should follow the same guidelines as its use as an oral contraceptive. The dosage regimen for acne treatment, as provided in a DIALPAK® Tablet Dispenser, involves taking one active tablet daily for 21 days, followed by one green inactive tablet daily for 7 days. After completing the 28 tablets, a new course is started the next day. For further information on dosing, refer to the FDA Package Insert, which includes details on indications, contraindications, side effects, drug interactions, and administration instructions. Additional resources include online calculators for creatinine clearance and weight conversion, as well as recent publications, trial results, and evidence-based guidelines. Media resources such as slides, videos, images, and podcasts are also available, along with patient resources like discussion groups, handouts, blogs, and news updates. International resources and materials in Spanish are accessible as well.
